results.bound: N^{1-\delta} query time with polynomial preprocessing
results.quote: Assuming SETH, for any \(\delta>0\), there exists a constant \(\gamma\in(1,2)\) such that \(\gamma\)-ANN under the \(\ell_\infty\) norm cannot be solved with polynomial preprocessing and \(N^{1-\delta}\) query time.

Assuming SETH, for any \(\delta>0\) and \(\gamma<3\), there exists a constant c\>_0 such that \(\gamma\)-approximate Bichromatic Closest Pair on instances with dimension d=c\(\log N\) under the \(\ell_\infty\) norm cannot be solved in \(N^{2-\delta}\) time.

results.bound: N^{1-\delta} query time with polynomial preprocessing on instances with d=c\log N
results.quote: Assuming SETH, for any \(\delta>0\) and \(\gamma<3\), there exists a constant c\>_0 such that \(\gamma\)-ANN on instances with dimension d=c\(\log N\) under the \(\ell_\infty\) norm cannot be solved with polynomial preprocessing and \(N^{1-\delta}\) query time.
